title: Delta Sigma Modulator
text: ADC based on delta-sigma modulator, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Delta Sigma Modulator order} sets Order of delta-sigma modulator 2nd; {Delta Sigma Modulator architecture} sets the architecture of delta-sigma, {System bandwidth (Hz)} sets the bandwidth of delta-sigma modulator system, {OSR} sets the ratio of delta-sigma modulator sampling rate to Nyquist, {Sampling frequency (Hz)} sets the sampling frequency of delta-sigma modulator, {Quantizer levels} sets the number of quantizer levels in delta-sigma, {Quantizer output} sets the range of quantizer output, {Enable dynamic range scaling}, {Use custom coefficient values} sets the option to use custom values, {Coefficient ’a’} sets the feedback/feed-forward coefficients from/to the quantizer, {Coefficient ’g’} sets the resonator coefficients, {Coefficient ’b’} sets the feed-in coefficients from the modulator input to each integrator, {Coefficient ’c’} sets the integrator inter-stage coefficients, {Integrator opamp gain} sets the open loop gain, {Enable Noise Impairment} enables noise calculations in delta-sigma modulator, {Thermal noise value} sets the thermal noise density 200e-6, {Reference resistance (ohm)} sets the reference resistance for power calculation, {1/f corner frequency (Hz)} sets the corner frequency for flicker noise, {NTF zeros opitimization flag} sets the method to optimize zeros in NTF, {Modulator passband} sets the type of modulator, {Center frequency}, {Use custom value of H_inf} sets the option to use custom value of H_inf, {Maximum out-of-band H_inf} sets the maximum out-of-band gain of NTF, {Noise transfer function (NTF)} plots NTF, {NTF pole-zero plot} sets the visualize pole and zero locations of NTF, {Signal transfer function (STF)} plots STF, {Predict SNR}, {Append plots}, {Generate analysis plots} plots selected analysis and {Export analysis data to workspace} sets the export analyzed data to base workspace. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Delta Sigma Modulator architecture
params.values: Architecture of delta-sigma modulator CIFB (default) | CRFB | CIFF | CRFF

params.name: Delta Sigma Modulator order
params.values: Order of delta-sigma modulator 2nd order (default) | 1st order | 3rd order | 4th order | 5th order | 6th order

params.name: System bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Bandwidth of delta-sigma modulator system 1000 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: OSR
params.values: Ratio of delta-sigma modulator sampling rate to Nyquist rate 64 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Sampling frequency (Hz)
params.values: Sampling frequency of delta-sigma modulator 128e3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Quantizer levels
params.values: Number of quantizer levels in delta-sigma modulator 2 (default) | positive real integer

params.name: Quantizer output
params.values: Range of quantizer output [-1,1] (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Enable dynamic range scaling
params.values: Enable dynamic range scaling of coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Use custom coefficient values
params.values: Option to use custom values for coefficients ’a’, ’g’, ’b’, and ’c’ off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficient ’a’
params.values: Feedback/feed-forward coefficients from/to the quantizer [0.1601 0.6515] (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Coefficient ’g’
params.values: Resonator coefficients [0.0000] (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Coefficient ’b’
params.values: Feed-in coefficients from the modulator input to each integrator [0.1601 0.6515 1.0000] (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Coefficient ’c’
params.values: Integrator inter-stage coefficients [1.0000 1.0000] (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Integrator opamp gain
params.values: Open loop gain of op-amp Inf (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable Noise Impairment
params.values: Enable noise calculations in delta-sigma modulator ADC off (default) | on

params.name: Thermal noise value
params.values: Thermal noise density 200e-6 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Reference resistance (ohm)
params.values: Reference resistance for power calculation 50 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: 1/f corner frequency (Hz)
params.values: Corner frequency for flicker noise 1000 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: NTF zeros opitimization flag
params.values: Method to optimize zeros in NTF 2 (default) | 0 | 1

params.name: Modulator passband
params.values: Type of modulator passband Lowpass (default) | Bandpass

params.name: Center frequency
params.values: Center frequency of modulator 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0 0.5]

params.name: Use custom value of H_inf
params.values: Option to use custom value of H_inf off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum out-of-band H_inf
params.values: Maximum out-of-band gain of NTF 1.4 (default) | positive real scalar
